payload.authorization: 2026-09-15 user explicitly authorized the next isolated zero-oracle complete-macro selector milestone after sealing the compositional generator baseline
payload.scientific_problem: The compositional generator produces diverse and novel exact local patches, but its learned order is weak at K=8 and K=32. Test whether a source-conditioned complete-macro selector can move training-like successful transformations earlier without changing generated support.
payload.primary_model_output: A scalar source-conditioned score for one already generated, complete, exactly realized one- or two-construction-event structural macro and endpoint.
payload.central_claim_under_test: A split-first complete-macro pairwise selector trained on successful training-source transformations and cross-fitted hard negative macros improves early held-source recovery or granular support over the immutable raw generator order while retaining exact realization and complete-macro diversity.
payload.evaluation_setting: Rerank only the 128 already locked balanced-joint-autoregressive candidates for each of the 15 T4 held sources under the same three whole-source folds. Compare with the immutable raw learned and uniform orders at K=8, K=16 and K=32.

split.training_positive_rule: For selector fold f, use exact T4 teacher source-to-endpoint structural goals only from the ten training sources of f.
split.crossfit_negative_rule: For each training source of f, take candidates from the immutable candidate-lock case in which that source was held out from its generator fit. Thus hard-negative generation itself did not fit on that source.
split.held_evaluation_rule: For selector fold f, use only the five held-source candidate cases originally generated by baseline fold f and load their teacher labels only after the selector checkpoint is frozen.

data.positive_object: One complete exactly reconstructed teacher structural goal and its exact route endpoint from the source state.
data.negative_object: One complete exactly realized generated structural macro and endpoint from the balanced-joint-autoregressive pool.
data.hard_negative_order: Take the earliest raw-generator candidates that match neither an exact teacher endpoint nor a radius-two teacher transformation class for that same training source.
data.weighting: Equal source mass; within source equal positive-route mass; within positive equal hard-negative mass.
data.missing_label_policy: If a fold lacks a positive, 32 eligible same-source hard negatives, an exact goal, a realization receipt or a source mapping, abstain for that fold and report coverage and the exact reason. Never inject or synthesize a label.

model.architecture: The existing small linear ContextSubgoalRanker and proposal_features over source graph, endpoint graph, graph delta and jointly aggregated complete structural-goal templates.
model.reuse: Reuse fit_context_subgoal_ranker without changing its feature map, optimizer or checkpoint schema.

compiler_cost_auxiliary.raw_feature: log1p(primitive_count + expanded + attempted) from the immutable exact-realization receipt
compiler_cost_auxiliary.normalization: mean and standard deviation fit only on selector-fold training hard negatives, with scale floor 0.05
compiler_cost_auxiliary.realizability_rule: Only candidates carrying status=realized, endpoint_matches_bound_target=true and primitive_teacher_actions_used=0 are rankable. Rejected compiler attempts are unavailable in the lock, so no realizability classifier is fit and that coverage is reported as unsupported.

model.score: context_ranker_score minus 0.05 times normalized observed compiler work
model.checkpoint_contents: Numeric ranker moments and coefficients, numeric compiler-cost moments, fixed policy configuration and input identities only.

selection.candidate_support: Exactly the immutable 128 balanced-joint-autoregressive candidates per held source; no union, regeneration, teacher injection or support expansion.
selection.tie_break: descending selector score, then original generator rank, endpoint key and candidate payload identity
selection.diversity_guard: Before any repeated exact complete-macro signature, greedily emit the best remaining candidate with an unseen sorted patch-id tuple; fill from repeats only after all available signatures are represented.

acceptance.diversity_floor: At every K, selector unique endpoint yield and exact complete-macro signature yield must be no lower than raw learned ordering.
acceptance.scientific_improvement_gate: At K=8, K=16 or K=32, selector must strictly improve raw learned source-balanced exact endpoint recall, radius-two transformation recall, exact patch recall or granular held-component coverage, without lower exact-realization precision or diversity.

payload.negative_result_policy: If the selector does not improve early held support, preserve the result and localize failure to feature/fit ranking versus immutable generator support. Do not change support, folds, labels, compiler or thresholds after evaluation.
payload.interpretation_limit: This is an offline zero-oracle ordering test over an already generated candidate lock. It is not evidence of docking utility, autonomous route recovery, prospective optimization or IVG superiority.
